answer: A reputation ledger that charges agents for the right to wander: every new agent must stake tokens and complete verifiable work before it can transact, while peers rate each interaction. A sybil operator spawning a nebula of fake identities pays the stake and work cost per identity, and one bad actor's reputation flows downstream like a river, tainting its whole cluster so honest agents route around it. Forging thousands of identities costs more than the value they can extract.
